27476-the-sign-of-the-spider.title: The Sign Of The Spider
27476-the-sign-of-the-spider.creator: Unknown
27476-the-sign-of-the-spider.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. He was accustomed to being thus talked at. He ought to be, seeing he had known about thirteen years of it, on and off. But he did not like it any the better from force of habit. We doubt if anybody ever does. However, he had long ceased to take any notice, in the way of retort, no matter how acrid the tone, how biting the innuendo.

arxiv-2004-07355.title: Time-domain Wavefield Reconstruction Inversion in a TTI medium.
arxiv-2004-07355.creator: Mathias Louboutin, Gabrio Rizzuti, Felix J. Herrmann
arxiv-2004-07355.description: Abstract 1 Abstract We introduce a generalization of time-domain wavefield reconstruction inversion to anisotropic acoustic modeling. Wavefield reconstruction inversion has been extensively researched in recent years for its ability to mitigate cycle skipping. The original method was formulated in the frequency domain with acoustic isotropic physics.

arxiv-2012-01576.title: Enhancement of Spatial Clustering-Based Time-Frequency Masks using LSTM Neural Networks
arxiv-2012-01576.creator: Felix Grezes, Zhaoheng Ni, Viet Anh Trinh, Michael Mandel
arxiv-2012-01576.description: Abstract Recent works have shown that Deep Recurrent Neural Networks using the LSTM architecture can achieve strong single-channel speech enhancement by estimating time-frequency masks. However, these models do not naturally generalize to multi-channel inputs from varying microphone configurations. In contrast, spatial clustering techniques can achieve such generalization but lack a strong signal model.

arxiv-2203-15915.title: Thermal Noise-Limited Laser Stabilization to an 8 mL Volume Fabry-Pérot Reference Cavity with Microfabricated Mirrors
arxiv-2203-15915.creator: Charles A. McLemore, Naijun Jin, Megan L. Kelleher, James P. Hendrie, David Mason, Yizhi Luo, Dahyeon Lee, Peter Rakich, Scott A. Diddams, Franklyn Quinlan
arxiv-2203-15915.description: Abstract Lasers stabilized to vacuum-gap Fabry-Pérot optical reference cavities display extraordinarily low noise and high stability, with linewidths much less than 1 Hz. These lasers can expand into new applications and ubiquitous use with the development of compact, portable cavities that are manufacturable at scale.

arxiv-2212-04511.title: No Need for Extreme Stellar Masses at z ∼ 7 z\sim 7 : A Test-case Study of COS-87259 Journal: ApJL
arxiv-2212-04511.creator: Sophie E. van Mierlo, Karina I. Caputi, Vasily Kokorev
arxiv-2212-04511.description: Abstract Recent controversy regarding the existence of massive ( log ⁡ ( M ∗ / M ⊙ ) ≳ 11 \log(M_{*}/M_{\odot})\gtrsim 11 ) galaxies at z > 6 z>6 poses a challenge for galaxy formation theories. Hence, it is of critical importance to understand the effects of SED fitting methods on stellar mass estimates of Epoch of Reionization galaxies.

arxiv-2302-06425.title: The Upper Bound on Antenna Gain and Its Feasibility as a Sum of Characteristic Gains
arxiv-2302-06425.creator: Miloslav Capek, Lukas Jelinek
arxiv-2302-06425.description: Abstract The upper bound on antenna gain is expressed as a sum of lossy characteristic modes, specifically, as a sum of characteristic far fields squared. The procedure combines the favorable properties of Harrington’s classical approach to maximum directivity and current-density-based approaches.

arxiv-2304-00818.title: Swarm Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Mesh Refinement
arxiv-2304-00818.creator: Niklas Freymuth Philipp Dahlinger Tobias Würth Simon Reisch, Luise Kärger Gerhard Neumann
arxiv-2304-00818.description: Abstract Adaptive Mesh Refinement (AMR) enhances the Finite Element Method, an important technique for simulating complex problems in engineering, by dynamically refining mesh regions, enabling a favorable trade-off between computational speed and simulation accuracy. Classical methods for AMR depend on heuristics or expensive error estimators, hindering their use for complex simulations.

arxiv-2305-12324.title: CHARACTER DEGREE GRAPH OF SOLVABLE GROUPS WITH ODD DEGREE
arxiv-2305-12324.creator: G. Sivanesan, C. Selvaraj
arxiv-2305-12324.description: Abstract . Let G G be a finite group, let I ​ r ​ r ​ ( G ) Irr(G) be the set of all complex irreducible characters of G G and let c ​ d ​ ( G ) cd(G) be the set of all degrees of characters in I ​ r ​ r ​ ( G ) .

arxiv-2405-17180.title: Boolean Gates Based on Liquid Marbles
arxiv-2405-17180.creator: Luca Cavenaghi, Sandro Erba, Claudio Zandron
arxiv-2405-17180.description: Abstract Liquid Marbles are liquid droplets encapsulated by hydrophobic powder particles. They offer an efficient approach to handling liquids due to their non-wetting nature. In this work, starting from the interaction gate proposed in the literature, we describe how the logic gates AND, XOR, OR, NOT, NAND, and NOR could be realized.

arxiv-2408-05995.title: Searching for long-lived light neutralinos and axionlike particles at the SHiNESS experiment
arxiv-2408-05995.creator: Zeren Simon Wang, Yu Zhang, Wei Liu
arxiv-2408-05995.description: Abstract Recently Soleti et al. [ JHEP03(2024)148 ] proposed a new experiment called SHiNESS at the upcoming European Spallation Source (ESS) facility, making use of the 2-GeV proton beam there impinging on a fixed target, in order to search for hidden sterile neutrinos that could lie in different mass ranges and arise with distinct signatures.

arxiv-2503-02130.title: Forgetting Transformer: Softmax Attention with a Forget Gate
arxiv-2503-02130.creator: Zhixuan Lin, Evgenii Nikishin, Xu Owen He, Aaron Courville
arxiv-2503-02130.description: Abstract An essential component of modern recurrent sequence models is the forget gate . While Transformers do not have an explicit recurrent form, we show that a forget gate can be naturally incorporated into Transformers by down-weighting the unnormalized attention scores in a data-dependent way.

arxiv-2503-07443.title: Volume dependence of microwave induced excess quasiparticles in superconducting resonators
arxiv-2503-07443.creator: Steven A. H. de Rooij, Jochem J. A. Baselmans, Juan Bueno, Vignesh Murugesan, David J. Thoen, Pieter J. de Visser
arxiv-2503-07443.description: Abstract The presence of quasiparticles typically degrades the performance of superconducting microwave circuits. The readout signal can generate non-equilibrium quasiparticles, which lead to excess microwave loss and decoherence. To understand this effect quantitatively, we measure quasiparticle fluctuations and extract the quasiparticle density across different temperatures, readout powers, and resonator volumes.

arxiv-2505-00372.title: Towards Adaptive Self-Normalized Importance Samplers
arxiv-2505-00372.creator: Nicola Branchini, Víctor Elvira
arxiv-2505-00372.description: Abstract The self-normalized importance sampling (SNIS) estimator is a Monte Carlo estimator widely used to approximate expectations in statistical signal processing and machine learning. The efficiency of SNIS depends on the choice of proposal, but selecting a good proposal is typically unfeasible. In particular, most of the existing adaptive IS (AIS) literature overlooks the optimal SNIS proposal.

arxiv-2509-05054.title: Non-residually finite C ~ 2 \tilde{C}_{2} -lattices
arxiv-2509-05054.creator: Thomas Titz Mite, Stefan Witzel
arxiv-2509-05054.description: Abstract We provide the first known examples of non-residually finite lattices on irreducible buildings. They contain the first known simple CAT ⁡ ( 0 ) \CAT(0) -groups with property (T), and the first known CAT ⁡ ( 0 ) \CAT(0) -groups that are not quasi-isometric to a direct product.

arxiv-2509-06626.title: Network-level Censorship Attacks in the InterPlanetary File System
arxiv-2509-06626.creator: Jan Matter, Muoi Tran
arxiv-2509-06626.description: Abstract The InterPlanetary File System (IPFS) has been successfully established as the de facto standard for decentralized data storage in the emerging Web3. Despite its decentralized nature, IPFS nodes, as well as IPFS content providers, have converged to centralization in large public clouds [ 4 ] [ 10 ] .

arxiv-2510-10209.title: LOOPerSet: A Large-Scale Dataset for Data-Driven Polyhedral Compiler Optimization
arxiv-2510-10209.creator: Massinissa Merouani, Afif Boudaoud, Riyadh Baghdadi
arxiv-2510-10209.description: Abstract The advancement of machine learning for compiler optimization, particularly within the polyhedral model, is constrained by the scarcity of large-scale, public performance datasets. This data bottleneck forces researchers to undertake costly data generation campaigns, slowing down innovation and hindering reproducible research learned code optimization.

arxiv-2602-18603.title: Enhancing Goal Inference via Correction Timing Conference: Proc. of the 25th International Conference on Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems (AAMAS 2026); May 25 – 29, 2026; Paphos, Cyprus
arxiv-2602-18603.creator: Anjiabei Wang, Shuangge Wang, Tesca Fitzgerald
arxiv-2602-18603.description: Abstract . Corrections offer a natural modality for people to provide feedback to a robot, by (i) intervening in the robot’s behavior when they believe the robot is failing (or will fail) the task objectives and (ii) modifying the robot’s behavior to successfully fulfill the task.

pmc-10594590.title: Phosphonate and Thiasugar Analogues of Glucosamine-6-phosphate: Activation of the glmS Riboswitch and Antibiotic Activity
pmc-10594590.creator: Bjarne Silkenath, Dennis Kläge, Hanna Altwein, Nina Schmidhäuser, Günter Mayer, Jörg S. Hartig, Valentin Wittmann
pmc-10594590.description: The glmS riboswitch is a motif found in 5′-untranslated regions of bacterial mRNA that controls the synthesis of glucosamine-6-phosphate (GlcN6P), an essential building block for the bacterial cell wall, by a feedback mechanism. Activation of the glmS riboswitch by GlcN6P mimics interferes with the ability of bacteria to synthesize its cell wall.

pmc-10607443.title: A Comparison between SARS-CoV-2 and Gram-Negative Bacteria-Induced Hyperinflammation and Sepsis
pmc-10607443.creator: Klaus Brandenburg, Raquel Ferrer-Espada, Guillermo Martinez-de-Tejada, Christian Nehls, Satoshi Fukuoka, Karl Mauss, Günther Weindl, Patrick Garidel
pmc-10607443.description: Sepsis is a life-threatening condition caused by the body’s overwhelming response to an infection, such as pneumonia or urinary tract infection. It occurs when the immune system releases cytokines into the bloodstream, triggering widespread inflammation. If not treated, it can lead to organ failure and death.

pmc-10803412.title: Spanish validation of the simple lifestyle indicator questionnaire: validity and reliability analysis
pmc-10803412.creator: Elisabet Montero-Sandiego, Nicolás Ruiz-Robledillo, Rosario Ferrer-Cascales, Violeta Clement-Carbonell, Cristian Alcocer-Bruno, Natalia Albaladejo-Blázquez
pmc-10803412.description: IntroductionIt has been shown that lifestyle is a highly modifiable determinant having a direct effect on the health status. Therefore, short and simple questionnaires assessing the lifestyle of the general and clinical population are needed to create interventions on behavioral aspects that can improve the health status.

pmc-11396010.title: Gaming Disorders: Navigating the Fine Line between Entertainment and Addiction—Gaming History, Health Risks, Social Consequences, and Pathways to Prevention
pmc-11396010.creator: George Imataka, Shu Izumi, Yuji Miyamoto, Akira Maehashi, Gennaro Ruggiero
pmc-11396010.description: The number of people immersed in excessive gaming has increased in this age of rapid digitalization. The World Health Organization and American Psychiatric Association Organization recognize a gaming disorder as a condition that results in significant problems in daily life as a result of excessive gaming. Both organizations emphasize the similarities to behavioral addictions such as gambling.

pmc-11417324.title: Postpartum Renal Cortical Necrosis: A Case Series
pmc-11417324.creator: Lei Jiang, Suxia Wang, Ying Tan, Tao Su
pmc-11417324.description: Rationale & ObjectivePostpartum renal cortical necrosis (postpartum RCN) is a severe form of obstetric acute kidney injury. This study aimed to identify clinicopathologic features in Chinese postpartum RCN cases to determine how pathologic findings may contribute to the treatment and prognosis.Study DesignSingle-center, case series.

pmc-12449427.title: Modelling Volumetric Growth in Soft Solids via Residual Stress
pmc-12449427.creator: Ruoyu Huang, Raymond W Ogden, Raimondo Penta
pmc-12449427.description: In this paper the nonlinear elasticity theory of volumetric growth based on residual stress that was introduced in previous contribution (Huang et al. in J. Elast. 145:223–241, 2021) is developed further, and is then focused on an applications of the theory with computational examples.

pmc-12526535.title: Task Offloading and Resource Allocation Strategy in Non-Terrestrial Networks for Continuous Distributed Task Scenarios
pmc-12526535.creator: Yueming Qi, Yu Du, Yijun Guo, Jianjun Hao
pmc-12526535.description: Leveraging non-terrestrial networks for edge computing is crucial for the development of 6G, the Internet of Things, and ubiquitous digitalization. In such scenarios, diverse tasks often exhibit continuously distributed attributes, while existing research predominantly relies on qualitative thresholds for task classification, failing to accommodate quantitatively continuous task requirements.

pmc-12846387.title: The Impact of the COVID-19 Pandemic on the Epidemiology of Influenza in Hospitalised Children in the Years 2017–2025
pmc-12846387.creator: Zuzanna Wasielewska, Justyna Franczak, Krystyna Dobrowolska, Justyna Moppert, Małgorzata Sobolewska-Pilarczyk, Małgorzata Pawłowska
pmc-12846387.description: Background: The COVID-19 pandemic significantly altered the circulation of respiratory viruses, including influenza. This study aimed to compare the epidemiology and clinical characteristics of paediatric influenza before, during, and after the pandemic. Methods: We retrospectively analysed 553 children aged 0–18 years hospitalised with laboratory-confirmed influenza at a paediatric infectious disease centre in Bydgoszcz, Poland, between September 2017 and August 2025.

pmc-13227217.title: Pregnancy and lactation as window to maternal cardiovascular health☆
pmc-13227217.creator: Corinne E. Chatham, Egle Bytautiene Prewit, Daniela Crousillat, Alex M. Parker, Adetola F. Louis-Jacques
pmc-13227217.description: postpartum person and is a strategy to reduce CVD risk [3], [4], [5]. However, the protective role of lactation for maternal CVD health is our focus.

pmc-13366002.title: IFPHOR0035 Health Insurance and Maternal Healthcare Utilisation in Nigeria: A Scoping Review of the National Health Insurance Scheme
pmc-13366002.creator: Oluwadamisi Tayo-Ladega
pmc-13366002.description: BackgroundNigeria continues to experience a high burden of maternal mortality despite ongoing health system reforms aimed at improving access to maternal healthcare. Health insurance is widely recognised as a critical mechanism for reducing financial barriers and advancing progress toward universal health coverage.
